findings.description: What is worth changing, one finding each. Empty when nothing is: a review that invents work to look thorough is worse than a short one.

file.description: The file, by path from the workspace root.

line.description: The line the finding is about; null when it is about something absent, such as a test nobody wrote.

what.description: What would go wrong, concretely: the input or the case, and the wrong result.
